reader.notes: The image is read once through the sending extent (AsItemCharacters) and stored back through WriteGroupValue with AccessDir.Sending, so positions past the current count are untouched. The only edition switch on this path is the format 3 length hand-over (kb/Work PB5119), and it takes the 85 arm correctly.

refuter.evidence: q5.cob (q5-001 at --std 85, q5-002 at --std 2023, identical): 01 G. 05 GC PIC 9. 05 GE PIC X OCCURS 1 TO 5 DEPENDING ON GC. MOVE "3AAAAA" TO G, MOVE 3 TO GC, INSPECT G (2:) REPLACING ALL "A" BY "b", MOVE 5 TO GC, DISPLAY G printed M1=[5bbb  ]; G (2:) CONVERTING printed M3=[5ccc  ]; G (1:) printed M4=[5ddd  ]; G (K:) printed M5=[5eee  ]. G (2:3) printed M2=[5bbbAA] and plain G printed M6=[5fffAA]. q4.cob: INSPECT G (2:) TALLYING N FOR CHARACTERS gave 03, so the read uses the sending length 4. The statement reads 3 characters and writes 5: GE (4) and GE (5) lie outside identifier-1 under any reading, and they become spaces. q6.cob: the same with the object OUTSIDE the group (H (2:), OC 3) is right (AbbAAA). With the object inside, REPLACING CHARACTERS gives [5zzz  ]. Under GR1 with VI.5.8.4 GR3b, the unique item G (2:) is 3 characters (sending length 4, IV.4.3.8.4.4 GR4b). Under a receiving reading it would be 5 characters and all five A's would be replaced. Neither reading leaves positions 5-6 as spaces. Cause: the first arm of InspectEmitter#EmitStore, `if (p is RefModPlace) { w.Line(PlaceRenderer.Write(p, img)); return; }`, stores a reference-modified identifier-1 before the group arm that takes WriteGroupValue(..., AccessDir.Sending). A refmod with no length, over a group whose DEPENDING ON object is inside it, is therefore written at the group's maximum (receiving) extent, space-padded. The reader's own refmod probes (R1-R4) used an elementary X6, and its notes name the AccessDir.Sending store, which this arm skips. Other probes upheld: q1 G1 [5bbbAA], G2 [4ccAA], G3 OC=4; q4 Z1=01 (zero occurrences), S1=02 [5rrQQQ] (a subordinate group with the object outside). cite.py: OK §1985:VI.6.18.4 GR1 ("identifier-1 is treated as if it were a sending data item"); OK §1985:VI.5.8.4 GR3b ("only that part of the table area that is specified by the value of the data item referenced by data-name-1 at the start of the operation will be used in the operation"); OK §1985:IV.4.3.8.4.4 GR4b ("If length is not specified, the unique data item extends from and includes the character identified by leftmost-character-position"). kb/Work: PB5119 (landed) fixed the format 3 hand-over for G (2:), where the counter changes the object. It does not cover this format 2/4 store, where the object does not change. No note found for it.

adjudication.reason: INSPECT handles the characters inside the current count correctly; what it blanks lies past the DEPENDING ON value, whose content is undefined, so no conforming program can see it.
